errors.text_span: с етикети на всеки две години, започвайки от 2008 и завършвайки на 2019
errors.evidence: The x-axis labels are for every year from 2008 to 2019, not for every two years.

errors.text_span: Най-ниските стойности са отчетени през 2009, 2015 и 2016 година
errors.evidence: The lowest values are in 2015 (around -0.8%) and 2016 (around -0.3%). The value in 2009 is significantly higher, at approximately 0.1%, and is not one of the lowest points on the chart.

errors.text_span: като остава относително стабилна до 2019 година
errors.evidence: The description claims the value remains relatively stable until 2019, but the graph shows a clear decrease from 2018 (approx. 3.4%) to 2019 (approx. 2.4%).
